description: Send ZPL to a physical printer through the account's Labelixa DirectPrint agent. Requires an API key whose plan includes printing and a printer from printer_list (or a printer group name). The job is QUEUED, not printed: the response says whether the device is mapped by an agent and when the agent last connected; check print_status for delivery. Always show the user a zpl_preview before printing.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key; a retry with the same key returns the first job instead of printing again

printer_group.description: Printer group name, instead of device_id

name: print_label
title: Print label
